title: cdk-construct-express-sfn-error-notification examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples in packages/cdk-construct-express-sfn-error-notification/examples/.

Scenarios:
- minimal/ — required props (stepFunctions map, rateAlarmSnsTopicArn, volumeAlarmSnsTopicArn)
- multi-target/ — multiple Step Function targets in the stepFunctions map (divergent: multiple SQS+alarm sets)
- comprehensive/ — all optional props

All 5 languages. Assertion tests in test/express-sfn-error-notification-examples.test.ts.
